questions.question: The resistivity of a material is dependent on which of the following factors?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Temperature**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Temperature** is the factor on which the resistivity of a material depends.
 
• Resistivity is a fundamental property of a material that quantifies how strongly it resists or conducts electric current.
 
• As temperature increases, the resistivity of most conductive materials increases due to increased lattice vibrations, which impede the flow of electrons.
 
• In some materials, such as semiconductors, resistivity decreases with an increase in temperature due to an increase in charge carriers.
 
• Understanding the relationship between resistivity and temperature is crucial for designing electrical and electronic systems that operate efficiently under varying thermal conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resistance** is a property of an object and depends on the object's shape and size, whereas **resistivity** is a material property and is independent of the object's dimensions.
 
• The formula for resistance is *R = ρ(L/A)*, where *ρ* is the resistivity, *L* is the length, and *A* is the cross-sectional area.
 
• For most metals, resistivity increases linearly with temperature and can be expressed as *ρ(T) = ρ0[1 + α(T - T0)]*, where *ρ0* is the resistivity at a reference temperature *T0* and *α* is the temperature coefficient of resistivity.
 
• Materials with low resistivity, such as copper and aluminum, are used as conductors, while materials with high resistivity, such as rubber and glass, are used as insulators.

__
 
• The correct order of reactivity for the given metals is **K > Na > Zn > Cu > Hg > Ag**.
 
• Potassium (K) and Sodium (Na) are alkali metals and are highly reactive.
 
• Zinc (Zn) is a transition metal and is less reactive than Potassium and Sodium but more reactive than Copper (Cu), Mercury (Hg), and Silver (Ag).
 
• Copper (Cu), Mercury (Hg), and Silver (Ag) are less reactive compared to the other metals listed.
 
• This reactivity series helps in predicting the outcomes of reactions involving these metals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The reactivity series is a list of metals arranged in order of decreasing reactivity.
 
• It is used to determine the products of single displacement reactions, predict the outcomes of reactions involving metals, and understand the extraction of metals from their ores.
 
• Metals at the top of the reactivity series, such as Potassium and Sodium, react vigorously with water and acids.
 
• Metals lower in the series, like Copper, Mercury, and Silver, do not react as easily and are often found in nature in their elemental form.
 
• The position of metals in the reactivity series is determined based on their ability to displace hydrogen from acids and water.

questions.question: Panchayati Raj Institutions in India have been established following the _______ of the Constitution Of India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**73rd amendment Act**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Panchayati Raj Institutions in India have been established following the **73rd Amendment Act** of the Constitution of India.
 
• This amendment was enacted in **1992** and came into effect on **24th April 1993**.
 
• The 73rd Amendment Act added **Part IX** to the Constitution, titled "The Panchayats", and also added the Eleventh Schedule which contains **29 functional items** that panchayats are responsible for.
 
• The amendment aimed to provide a constitutional status to the Panchayati Raj institutions and ensure a more decentralized form of governance.
 
• It mandates the establishment of panchayats at the village, intermediate, and district levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written** constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Panchayati Raj system aims to build democracy at the grassroots level and is a vital aspect of India's democratic structure.

questions.question: Which of the following substances are selectively reabsorbed from the initial filtrate by the tubular portion of the nephron in human kidney?

options.text: Glucose, water, amino acids and proteins

__
 
• In the human kidney, the nephron is the functional unit responsible for filtering blood and forming urine.
 
• **Selective reabsorption** occurs in the tubular portion of the nephron, where essential substances are reabsorbed back into the bloodstream.
 
• Substances that are selectively reabsorbed from the initial filtrate include **glucose, water, salts, and amino acids**.
 
• This process ensures that essential nutrients and electrolytes are conserved while waste products are excreted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The nephron consists of several parts, including the Bowman's capsule, proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle, distal convoluted tubule, and collecting duct.
 
• Each part of the nephron plays a specific role in the filtration and reabsorption processes.
 
• Reabsorption in the proximal convoluted tubule is responsible for the majority of nutrient reabsorption, including glucose and amino acids.
 
• Water reabsorption occurs throughout the nephron but is especially significant in the loop of Henle and collecting duct.
 
• The kidneys maintain homeostasis by regulating the volume and composition of body fluids through these processes.

questions.question: Which of the following rules is used to determine the direction of induced current due to the motion of coil at right angle to the magnetic field?

__
 
• **Fleming's right-hand rule** is used to determine the direction of induced current when a conductor, such as a coil, moves at right angles to a magnetic field.
 
• According to this rule, if you stretch the thumb, forefinger, and middle finger of your right hand such that they are mutually perpendicular, the thumb indicates the direction of motion of the conductor, the forefinger points in the direction of the magnetic field, and the middle finger indicates the direction of the induced current.
 
• This rule is essential in the context of electromagnetic induction, where mechanical energy is converted into electrical energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fleming's left-hand rule** is used for electric motors, where the direction of current and magnetic field determines the direction of force on the conductor.
 
• **Maxwell's corkscrew rule** and **Right-hand thumb rule** are used to find the direction of magnetic fields around a current-carrying conductor.
 
• Understanding these rules is crucial for working with electric motors and generators.

questions.question: A cost incurred in the past and that cannot be recovered in the future is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**sunk cost**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **sunk cost** is a cost that has already been incurred and cannot be recovered.
 
• It is important in decision-making to ignore sunk costs because they should not affect future decisions.
 
• Sunk costs are contrasted with prospective costs, which are future costs that may be incurred or changed if an action is taken.
 
• Examples of sunk costs include past investments in machinery, research, or any other expense that cannot be undone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunk cost fallacy** is a common logical error where individuals continue an endeavor solely because of previously invested resources (time, money, or effort).
 
• In economics and business decision-making, recognizing sunk costs helps in focusing on future costs and benefits rather than past expenses.
 
• The concept of sunk cost is crucial in cost accounting and managerial accounting, where it aids in evaluating the true cost of decisions.
 
• Ignoring sunk costs can lead to more rational and effective decision-making processes.

questions.question: A convex mirror used as a rear-view mirror of a car has a focal length of 2 m. If a bus is located at a distance of 3 m from the mirror, where will its image be formed?

options.text: 0.83 m in front of the mirror
1.2 m in front of the mirror

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Focal length (f) = 2 meters (positive for convex mirror)

Object distance (u) = (-3) meters (negative because the object is in front of the mirror)

**Formula Used:**

1/f = 1/v + 1/u

**Calculations:**

Substitute the given values in the formula,

1/2 = 1/v + 1/(-3)

⇒ 1/2 = 1/v - 1/3

⇒ 1/2 + 1/3 = 1/v

⇒ 3/6 + 2/6 = 1/v

⇒ 5/6 = 1/v

⇒ v = 6/5 = 1.2 meters

**∴ The image of the bus will be formed at a distance of 1.2 meters behind the mirror.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• A convex mirror always forms a virtual, erect, and diminished image regardless of the position of the object.
 
• The image formed by a convex mirror is always located behind the mirror.
 
• Convex mirrors are commonly used in vehicles as rear-view mirrors because they provide a wider field of view.

questions.question: If 5 + x, 2x + 7, 6x + 9, and y are in proportion when x = 2, find the value of y.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 + x, 2x + 7, 6x + 9, and y are in proportion when x = 2.

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d

**Calculation:**

When x = 2:

5 + x = 5 + 2 = 7

2x + 7 = 2(2) + 7 = 4 + 7 = 11

6x + 9 = 6(2) + 9 = 12 + 9 = 21

Since they are in proportion:

7 / 11 = 21 / y

Cross-multiply to solve for y:

7y = 21 × 11

7y = 231

questions.question: Soil degradation is one of the major environmental problems being faced these days. A wide range of techniques to conserve soil are mentioned below. Select the INCORRECT option.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Overgrazing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Overgrazing **allows animals to graze on vegetation faster than it can regenerate, exposing the soil to erosion and reducing its organic matter content.
 
• It is **detrimental to soil health and contributes to degradation**.
 
• It not only impacts soil health but also contributes to climate change, reduces food security, and disrupts local communities.
 
• 
 
**Negative Impacts **of overgrazing:

 
 
• 
 
**Erosion**: When vegetation is overgrazed, the soil becomes exposed to the elements, making it vulnerable to wind and water erosion. This washes away topsoil, the most fertile layer, reducing soil productivity and leading to desertification.

 
 
• 
 
**Compaction**: Excessive trampling by animals compacts the soil, making it harder for water and air to infiltrate. This creates unfavorable conditions for plant growth and reduces the soil's ability to store water.

 
 
• 
 
**Nutrient depletion**: Overgrazing prevents proper nutrient cycling as plants have less time to grow and return organic matter to the soil. This reduces soil fertility and necessitates the use of fertilizers, often leading to further environmental issues.

 
 
• 
 
**Biodiversity loss**: Overgrazing can disrupt delicate ecosystems, reducing plant diversity and impacting animal populations that rely on specific vegetation for food and shelter.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Crop rotation**: This technique** involves planting different crops in the same field over time**, allowing the soil to recover nutrients depleted by the previous crop.

 
 
• This helps maintain soil fertility and reduces erosion.
 
 
 
• **Terrace farming**: This **technique involves creating leveled platforms on sloping land to slow down water flow and prevent soil erosion**.
 
 
• This is particularly helpful in **mountainous regions**.
 
 
 
• **Planting trees**: Trees play a crucial role in soil conservation by holding the soil in place with their roots, reducing wind and water erosion.
 
 
• Their leaves also decompose and add organic matter to the soil, improving its fertility.

Father's age six years ago = 6 × Daughter's age six years ago

⇒ Father's age = y - 6

⇒ Daughter's age = x - 6

⇒ y - 6 = 6(x - 6) ...(1)

⇒ Three years hence:

⇒ Father's age = y + 3

⇒ Daughter's age = x + 3

⇒ y + 3 = 3(x + 3) ...(2)

⇒ From Equation (1):

⇒ 6x - 3x = 9 + 27

**∴ The present age of the daughter is 12 years.**

questions.question: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.text: Pyruvic acid is produced in the first stage of respiration.
Oxygen is not necessary for the fermentation process.
In the mitochondria, acetic acid is broken down utilising oxygen.
In the first stage of respiration, breakdown of glucose takes place.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**in the mitochondria, acetic acid is broken down utilising oxygen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pyruvic acid is produced in the first stage of respiration**. This is the correct statement. The first stage of respiration, also known as glycolysis, occurs in the cytoplasm of the cell and breaks down glucose into pyruvic acid. Oxygen is not required for this stage.
 
• **Oxygen is not necessary for the fermentation process.** This is the correct statement. Fermentation is an anaerobic process and does not require oxygen.
 
• **In the mitochondria, acetic acid is broken down utilizing oxygen.** This statement is **incorrect**. The Krebs cycle, which occurs in the mitochondria, breaks down pyruvate (not acetic acid) into even simpler molecules and utilizes oxygen in the process. Acetic acid is a product of some fermentation pathways and cannot enter the Krebs cycle directly.
 
• **In the first stage of respiration, breakdown of glucose takes place.** Glycolysis, which is the first stage of respiration, involves the breakdown of glucose into pyruvate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Respiration** is a multi-stage process that includes glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, and the electron transport chain.
 
• During **glycolysis**, one molecule of glucose is converted into two molecules of pyruvate, with a net gain of two ATP molecules.
 
• The **Krebs cycle** occurs in the mitochondria and involves the oxidation of acetyl-CoA to produce ATP, NADH, and FADH2.
 
• The **electron transport chain** uses the electrons from NADH and FADH2 to generate a large amount of ATP through oxidative phosphorylation.
 
• **Fermentation** allows cells to produce ATP without oxygen by converting pyruvate into lactic acid or ethanol and carbon dioxide.

• It also helps in maintaining the plant's temperature and facilitates the movement of water and nutrients through the xylem.
 
• Guard cells are able to respond to environmental cues such as light, carbon dioxide concentration, and internal water pressure to regulate stomatal opening and closing.
 
• The efficiency of transpiration can be affected by factors such as temperature, humidity, wind, and soil water availability.

questions.solution:
**Given:**

We need to find the number of 2-digit numbers divisible by both 2 and 4.

**Formula Used:**

A number divisible by both 2 and 4 is divisible by the LCM of 2 and 4, which is 4.

Count of 2-digit numbers divisible by 4 = (Last 2-digit number divisible by 4 - First 2-digit number divisible by 4) / 4 + 1

**Calculation:**

First 2-digit number divisible by 4 = 12

Last 2-digit number divisible by 4 = 96

Count = (96 - 12) / 4 + 1

⇒ Count = 84 / 4 + 1

⇒ Count = 21 + 1

questions.question: Which of the following features says that people of India have a direct role in electing their representatives?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Parliamentary Form of Government**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Parliamentary Form of Government** ensures that the people of India have a direct role in electing their representatives.
 
• In this system, citizens elect Members of Parliament (MPs) to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of India's Parliament, through **general elections**.
 
• The elected representatives are accountable to the people and must seek their mandate periodically, ensuring a direct link between the electorate and their representatives.
 
• This form of government is characterized by a **dual executive system**, comprising the President and the Prime Minister, with the latter being the head of government and responsible to the Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Parliamentary system** in India is inspired by the British model, emphasizing the supremacy of the Parliament.
 
• General elections are held every **five years** to elect members to the Lok Sabha, which represents the will of the people.
 
• The **Prime Minister**, who is the **leader of the majority party or coalition** in the Lok Sabha, is appointed by the** President** and is responsible for **running the government**.
 
• This system promotes democratic values by ensuring that the government remains accountable to the people through their elected representatives.
 
• The **Parliamentary Form of Government** is enshrined in the Constitution of India, which came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It reinforces the democratic principle that the ultimate authority rests with the people, who exercise their power through periodic elections.

questions.question: A ray of light is incident on an interface separating two media along the normal to the interface. The angle between the incident ray and refracted ray is equal to:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**0°**__.

__
 
• The angle between the incident ray and the refracted ray is **0º** when the ray of light is incident on an interface along the normal to the interface.
 
• **When light travels along the normal (perpendicular) to the interface, it does not deviate**, hence the angle of refraction is 0º.
 
• This means the** light continues to travel in the same direction without bending**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Refraction is the bending of light as it passes from one medium to another.
 
• **Snell's Law **governs the refraction of light, which states that the ratio of the sines of the angles of incidence and refraction is constant for a given pair of media.
 
• However, when the incidence angle is 0º (along the normal), the sine of 0º is 0, leading to no refraction.

questions.question: A can finish painting a sari in 11 days, B in 20 days and C in 55 days, if they work independently. In how many days can the work be completed if A is assisted by B on every odd numbered day and by C on every even numbered day till the work completes?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can finish painting in 11 days

B can finish painting in 20 days

C can finish painting in 55 days

**Concept:**

Calculate the amount of work done by each worker per day.

Determine the combined work done by A and B on odd days, and A and C on even days.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 1/11

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 1/20

⇒ Work done by C in 1 day = 1/55

⇒ Work done by A + B on odd days = (1/11) + (1/20) = 31 / 220

⇒ Work done by A + C on even days = (1/11) + (1/55) = 66 / 605

⇒ Work done by A + C on even days = 6 / 55

⇒ Total work done in 2 days = (31 / 220) + (6 / 55) = 1/4

⇒ Total work = 1 (whole work)

⇒ Number of 2-day cycles needed = 1 / (1/4) = 4

⇒ Total days = 4 × 2 = 8

**∴ The work can be completed in 8 days.**

**Answer:** Option 4) 8 days
